name: LegalZoom Last Will and Testament

price.headline: Will: $89 one-time. Living trust: from $249.
price.note: Attorney consultations available separately. Business plan ($199/year) includes unlimited attorney consults.

key_facts.label: Documents
key_facts.value: Will, living trust, power of attorney, healthcare directive

key_facts.label: Attorney review
key_facts.value: Not included in base price; available as add-on

key_facts.label: Notarization
key_facts.value: Online notarization available in most states

key_facts.label: Updates
key_facts.value: Paid; new documents required for major changes

pros: Lower entry price than Trust & Will for basic wills
Brand recognition and 20+ years in legal services
Attorney network available for follow-up questions
cons: Attorney access costs extra beyond the base price
best_for: people who want a basic will at the lowest price
those who may want optional attorney access
skip_if: you need a living trust; Trust & Will's trust package is more straightforward for that specific need
rating_reason: A lower entry price for basic wills. The update model and extra charges for attorney access add friction over time.
